title: duplicate-identity errors could name which stale-copy shape they found (QCLI-424 AC3 follow-up)
description:
Filed from QCLI-424 AC3 at opum-agent's instruction (2026-09-30). QCLI-424 rewrote the duplicate-identity hint to name the second cause and its recovery; its third, requester-flagged OPTIONAL criterion asked the error (or `quest doctor`) to distinguish WHICH stale-copy shape it found -- the branch-switch/restore shape has tasks/<id>.json tracked at HEAD while completed/<id>.json is untracked or newly added -- and was left unpursued there because no design was decided. This record exists so that work has a home; it is deliberately unstarted.

THREE OPEN CHOICES, none decided, all needed before code:
1. Surface: report the shape on the conflict error itself, or via `quest doctor`.
2. Channel: hint prose, or an additive `input` field on the conflict envelope (the latter is a contract-shape choice).
3. Fallback: what to do when git state cannot be read -- no repository here, git unavailable, or a detached state.

FEASIBILITY, measured while closing QCLI-424: this is NOT blocked on capability. The git adapter at src/adapters/git/local-git.ts already spawns git safely (Bun.spawn, `git -C`) and its readBlob(revision, path) answers "is this path in HEAD" -- tracked-at-HEAD for tasks/<id>.json is one call; the untracked-or-newly-added half is the same call returning null at HEAD. The work is deciding the surface, channel and fallback, not building an ability.

CONSTRAINT, from opum-agent: when this is taken up, the surface and channel choice goes to the operator before any code (design authority). The measured shapes, hint text and tests live on QCLI-424 (src/cli/main.ts duplicate-identity hint; test/qcli424-duplicate-identity-guidance.test.ts) and QCLI-261's original.
plan: 1. Route the surface/channel/fallback decision to the operator (A/B packet sent 2026-09-30 via opum-agent).
2. Implement the shape detection per the decision, at the RecordDuplicateIdentityError branch in runQuest (src/cli/main.ts), where createGitPort() and resolvedRoot() are already in scope.
3. Extend test/qcli424-duplicate-identity-guidance.test.ts with the detected-shape assertion; mutation-check the guidance clause.
4. PR, required contexts green on the head, land on dev.
implementationNotes: ROUTED 2026-09-30 (session 08e30ebe). Restored from the QCLI-421 handoff; the first step is the surface/channel/fallback decision, and the A/B packet is with opum-agent as of this note. Evidence measured for it, with the repo build (bun 1.4.2, dev 2600fead) in a scratch workspace carrying the QCLI-424 measured shape -- task complete left uncommitted, then git reset --hard, leaving tasks/T-1.json tracked at HEAD beside an untracked completed/T-1.json: (1) quest doctor FAILS CLOSED on the duplicate: exit 5, the same task_lifecycle_duplicate_identity conflict envelope as every other command, so the doctor surface requires an explicit exception to the fail-closed invariant rather than being available as-is. (2) The conflict envelope today is {error_type, message, input:{duplicates:[{id, paths[] absolute}]}, hint, principal:null}; input is an EXISTING top-level key, so a nested shape field would not change the top-level key set. (3) The detection seam is the RecordDuplicateIdentityError branch of runQuest in src/cli/main.ts, where createGitPort() and resolvedRoot() are already in scope; readBlob(root, HEAD, .quest/<location>/<id>.json) answers tracked-at-HEAD per copy. No code written; nothing else owned.

IMPLEMENTED 2026-09-30 (session 08e30ebe) per DEC-92 option A, verified against the binding record (opum-agent origin/dev c6e7cf03, .quest/planning.json; operator chose A: one sentence in the hint, prose only, no structured field; fail-closed and the exit code unchanged; silent fallback when git cannot be read).

WHAT LANDED: the static hint moved to a DUPLICATE_IDENTITY_HINT const in src/cli/main.ts; duplicateIdentityShapeSentence() appends ONE sentence -- Detected shape for <ids>: the pre-move copy is tracked at HEAD while the moved copy is untracked or newly added -- this is cause (2) -- when a listed duplicate matches that signature. Detection is one readBlob(HEAD, path) call per listed path; null at HEAD IS the untracked-or-newly-added half (the QCLI-424 feasibility note). No envelope field is added, and the error type, message and exit code are untouched; every detector failure returns an empty suffix so the hint degrades silently. The mapping catch sits outside the try that declares the cached git and resolvedRoot, so the branch derives its own port and root -- cheap, and only on the already-failing path.

TESTS: test/qcli424-duplicate-identity-guidance.test.ts gains two -- the measured restore shape carries the sentence and the envelope key set is unchanged (the prose-only check), and a not-that-shape duplicate (move landed, pre-move copy recreated untracked) carries no sentence. Mutation proof: neutering the sentence reddens exactly the shape test (1 fail, 4 pass). Full check under pinned bun 1.4.2: 1074 pass, 0 fail.
finalSummary: QCLI-429 done, delivered by opum-ai/quest-cli#473 on DEC-92 option A. The duplicate-identity conflict hint now names the branch-switch/restore shape in ONE sentence when a listed duplicate matches it -- the pre-move copy tracked at HEAD while the moved copy is untracked or newly added -- tying it to cause (2) and the land-the-move recovery. Prose only: no envelope field, and the error type, message and exit code are unchanged; the detector degrades silently to the prior hint on anything unreadable, and it runs only on the already-failing path. Verified: mutation reddens exactly the shape test (1 fail, 4 pass); full bun run check under pinned bun 1.4.2 passes (1074 tests, 0 fail); Tracker integrity run 36802335872 validated f986700, with all three required contexts green on that head.
